report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned 200 with durations 63-172ms; metrics show /v1/checkout 200s and zero 502s, and traces show successful order/inventory/payment/postgres spans. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert reflects healthy latency. No bounded root cause can be substantiated, so hand off rather than assert a cause.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to determine whether 63-172ms is anomalous
Logs (ev-...-gw-logs excluded) to check for errors or warnings during the window
Downstream service latency metrics for order, inventory, payment to rule out downstream-latency
Confirmation of what symptom or threshold triggered this alert
